title: Preserve slashed beats and slash staff notation separately
scope: Retain both beat Slashed flags and per-staff slash notation preferences.
acceptance: A staff can request slash notation while a distinct beat has an authored slashed flag; neither replaces the other.
Test mixed notation preferences on two staves using PartConfiguration and GPIF where applicable.
Public edits and GP8 output preserve exact consumer flags without creating or deleting notes.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].showSlash. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
Exact raw consumer source and edited output assertions, including four isolated same-track target limits.
Hash-bound source/export artifacts, raw flags, public requests, strict errors, reports and literal acceptance checklist.

resolution: Implemented bounded PartConfiguration import and export with independent mutable per-staff requests, documented Track.Settings authority, and exact consumer-tested shared track flags. Beat.Slashed remains independent. Same-track divergent staff flags cannot survive the pinned consumer: each differing field reports its own omission without source mutation; strict export rejects it unless exactly allowed. Literal same-track final preservation remains residual acceptance, including dependencies on #86 for slash and numbered. Awaiting different-agent review and root combined gates; no closure claim.
verification: Focused public parser, independent occurrence/edit authority, malformed lengths and strict exact-code tests pass.
All nonzero four-bit combinations retain exact final pinned-consumer flags on separate tracks; zero flags use explicit standard-notation normalization.
Literal same-track independent consumer preservation remains a reproducible target limit and is not marked passed.
Semantic inventory adds six public fields and one GPIF wire field; fixture and corpus accounting updated.
Full conformance, capability probe and prek remain assigned to root integration.
